system.description: The death bond rolls damage on application and at each new round while this effect survives duration expiry. The victim may make a Constitution Situation roll (base value 6, adjusted by this casting) on each damage card: success avoids that round’s damage without ending the spell. Only grindsilver armor protects. Body Points are deducted after resolving the card.
system.summary: Drains life force; the victim may resist each round.
